requirements.Requirement: The vendor must provide a complete, current and accountable security questionnaire for the scoped service.
requirements.Pass condition: Questionnaire is complete, current, scoped and attested
requirements.Fail condition: Material sections are absent, stale or knowingly inaccurate

requirements.Requirement: Material control claims must be supported by independent assurance where the control is within the report scope.
requirements.Pass condition: Relevant controls are in scope and no unresolved material exception exists
requirements.Partial condition: Scope is adequate but a bounded non-material exception exists
requirements.Fail condition: Required controls are out of scope or a material exception is unresolved

requirements.Requirement: The service must support centralized workforce authentication for Mr. Mart users.
requirements.Pass condition: SSO is supported and applicable access paths are identified
requirements.Partial condition: A bounded low-risk access path is excluded with approved treatment
requirements.Fail condition: Material workforce access relies on unmanaged local credentials

requirements.Requirement: MFA must protect all privileged, administrative and vendor support access to the production service.
requirements.Required evidence: SOC 2 plus questionnaire; exceptions explicitly disclosed
requirements.Pass condition: All applicable privileged paths use MFA with no unresolved exception
requirements.Partial condition: Temporary exception has compensating control, owner and expiry
requirements.Fail condition: Any material privileged path lacks MFA or the exception is concealed

requirements.Requirement: Access must follow least privilege, role-based assignment and periodic review.
requirements.Applicability: Access to Mr. Mart data or administration
requirements.Pass condition: Roles are defined, approvals recorded and access reviewed at least quarterly
requirements.Partial condition: Review frequency or evidence has a bounded gap

requirements.Requirement: Joiner, mover, leaver and emergency-access processes must remove or bound access promptly.
requirements.Applicability: Vendor personnel or Mr. Mart users access the service
requirements.Pass condition: Lifecycle and emergency-access controls are defined and evidenced
requirements.Partial condition: Evidence supports design but operating evidence is incomplete
requirements.Fail condition: Terminated or emergency access can remain uncontrolled

requirements.Requirement: Customer data must be encrypted in transit and at rest using approved cryptographic controls.
requirements.Applicability: Any Mr. Mart customer data processed
requirements.Pass condition: Encryption covers all scoped storage and transmission paths
requirements.Partial condition: A non-material legacy path has an approved, time-bound treatment
requirements.Fail condition: Material customer data is transmitted or stored without encryption

requirements.Requirement: The vendor must process only approved data necessary for the customer-support purpose.
requirements.Pass condition: Purpose, data categories and prohibited data are explicit and consistent
requirements.Fail condition: Vendor processes prohibited data or uses data for an unapproved purpose

requirements.Requirement: Retention and deletion must be documented, configurable where required and completed after termination or approved expiry.
requirements.Pass condition: Retention, deletion events and verification obligations are defined
requirements.Partial condition: Deletion timing is bounded but needs contractual clarification
requirements.Fail condition: Indefinite/uncontrolled retention or no deletion commitment

requirements.Requirement: An executed DPA must define processing roles, instructions, confidentiality, rights support and incident obligations.
requirements.Pass condition: Current executed DPA contains all material obligations
requirements.Fail condition: No DPA or a material obligation is absent

requirements.Requirement: Material subprocessors and processing locations must be disclosed and governed by equivalent obligations.
requirements.Pass condition: Inventory, locations, purpose and change notification are defined
requirements.Fail condition: Material subprocessor or location is undisclosed

requirements.Requirement: Administrative, access and security events must be logged, monitored and retained for investigation.
requirements.Applicability: Production service processes Mr. Mart data
requirements.Pass condition: Material events are logged, monitored and retained for at least 12 months
requirements.Partial condition: Retention or monitoring evidence has a bounded non-material gap
requirements.Fail condition: Material privileged/security events are not logged or monitored

requirements.Requirement: The vendor must maintain vulnerability scanning, annual penetration testing and bounded remediation timelines.
requirements.Pass condition: Testing is current and critical/high findings follow defined remediation limits
requirements.Partial condition: One overdue non-critical item has documented treatment
requirements.Fail condition: Known critical exposure lacks bounded remediation

requirements.Requirement: Production changes must follow review, testing, approval and rollback controls.
requirements.Pass condition: Change controls are designed and operating
requirements.Partial condition: Operating evidence is incomplete but design is supported
requirements.Fail condition: Uncontrolled changes create material production risk

requirements.Requirement: The vendor must maintain an incident-response process and notify Mr. Mart promptly of incidents affecting scoped data or service.
requirements.Pass condition: Process, ownership, investigation and contractual notification within 24 hours of awareness are defined
requirements.Partial condition: Notification wording requires legal clarification without removing the duty
requirements.Fail condition: No response process or no material notification obligation

requirements.Requirement: The scoped service must have documented continuity and recovery capability tested at least annually.
requirements.Pass condition: Annual test supports RTO of 8 hours and RPO of 4 hours or better
requirements.Partial condition: Plan exists but one target/test detail needs clarification
requirements.Fail condition: No tested recovery capability or targets exceed appetite without treatment

requirements.Requirement: Backups supporting the scoped service must be protected and restoration-tested.
requirements.Pass condition: Backups are encrypted, isolated as appropriate and restoration-tested
requirements.Partial condition: Evidence supports backup design but recent restore proof is incomplete

requirements.Requirement: Any material policy exception must have an owner, rationale, compensating control, approval and expiry date.
requirements.Required evidence: Exception record linked to underlying evidence
requirements.Pass condition: Exception is explicit, approved, bounded and traceable
requirements.Fail condition: Exception is hidden, indefinite, ownerless or agent-created

evidence_rules.Freshness: Completed within 12 months and scoped to current service
evidence_rules.Required attributes: Owner/attestation, completion date, service scope, explicit qualifiers
evidence_rules.Can establish: Declared control design and vendor representation

evidence_rules.Authority: High for controls and tested period
evidence_rules.Freshness: Report period ends within 18 months; bridge evidence required when materially stale
evidence_rules.Required attributes: Auditor, entity/system scope, period, control, test result, exception
evidence_rules.Validation method: Scope, period, opinion, exception and citation validation
evidence_rules.Conflict treatment: Audited exception outranks questionnaire assertion for the tested period
evidence_rules.Can establish: Control design and operating effectiveness within scope

evidence_rules.Freshness: Current and applicable to the engagement
evidence_rules.Required attributes: Parties, execution state, service, data, roles, subprocessors, incident/deletion terms
evidence_rules.Validation method: Clause, party, version and execution validation
evidence_rules.Conflict treatment: Executed current terms outrank marketing or questionnaire descriptions
evidence_rules.Can establish: Binding obligations and defined processing terms

evidence_rules.Authority: Medium to high for resilience design; test proof needed for operation
evidence_rules.Freshness: Plan reviewed within 12 months; latest test within 12 months
evidence_rules.Required attributes: Scope, RTO, RPO, dependencies, test date, result, gaps
evidence_rules.Conflict treatment: Actual test result outranks untested plan language
evidence_rules.Can establish: Recovery design and evidenced test results

evidence_rules.Authority: Derived from source authority and consistency
evidence_rules.Freshness: Uses each source's own freshness rule
evidence_rules.Required attributes: Same control, entity, service, period and qualifier
evidence_rules.Validation method: Normalize and reconcile claims before policy evaluation
evidence_rules.Conflict treatment: Preserve contradiction; do not silently average or choose convenience
evidence_rules.Cannot establish alone: Truth when sources remain materially inconsistent

evidence_rules.Freshness: Same document version used for assessment
evidence_rules.Required attributes: Document ID/version, page/location, cited text, claim linkage

evidence_rules.Freshness: As defined per source or requirement
evidence_rules.Required attributes: Issue date, assessment date, coverage period and expiry
evidence_rules.Conflict treatment: Stale evidence cannot silently pass; request update or mark unable
evidence_rules.Cannot establish alone: Current control operation when coverage is stale

evidence_rules.Conflict treatment: Record gap and select clarification/unable outcome based on recoverability
evidence_rules.Cannot establish alone: Pass or fail of the underlying control

evidence_rules.Applies to: Exceptions, limitations, dates and scope statements
evidence_rules.Required attributes: Exact qualifier and relationship to claim
evidence_rules.Conflict treatment: Qualified claim cannot be promoted as unconditional

evidence_rules.Authority: Current executed/audited evidence normally outranks unsupported assertion
evidence_rules.Freshness: All sources must first be checked for comparable scope/time
evidence_rules.Conflict treatment: If authority does not resolve conflict, keep it open for adjudication
